mentions.name: Advanced tab organizer
mentions.description: This Chrome extension organizes large tab collections: it can group tabs into windows, search tabs (including within a specific window), and close duplicate tabs.
mentions.problem: The author's bad habit of accumulating 200+ open tabs.
mentions.source_excerpt: Advanced tab organizer, small chrome extension to organize my bad habit of 200+ tabs, can group them into windows, search, close duplicates, search just on a specific window.
